text:
Marcela Ortiz: Hi team — Marcela here, joining Platform today (remote, CET). Quick runbook Qs: who to ping for VPN/SSH and MDM enrollment? Also how do I get added to the internal confluence spaces and the #eng-platform channel? Any advice on laptop prefs? Oh and small fun fact: I bring my parrot to video calls occasionally 🦜

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Marcela!! :tada: Buddy is Carlos from Eng Infra, he'll reach out. For swag + shipping: https://redwood.company/swag-form. We'll note the parrot for video policy :) Any food allergies?

Carlos (Eng Infra): welcome! For SSH/VPN open the IT portal and paste your public key. Quick commands: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "marcela@redwood.com"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. I'll also add you to the WireGuard group and infra repos once IT ticket clears.

IT-Bot: IT ticket created: #IT-7901 "Onboard Marcela Ortiz: VPN/SSH/MDM/ACLs". ETA: 24 hours.

Asha (DevEx): For dotfiles and terminal config we recommend zsh + delta for diffs. Clone: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && ./install.sh`. If you want the minimal profile to avoid overwriting existing settings use `./install.sh --mini`.

Ivy (Platform): I've invited you to the eng-platform Confluence space and the internal calendar. You should see invites in your email; let me know if they don't show up.

Jo Park: If you need a laptop recommendation — M1/Pro Mac is standard, but we can do a Win laptop on request. If you're remote and want us to ship, pick on the swag form and include a shipping address.

Marcela Ortiz: Thanks all! No allergies. Will open the portal ticket and DM Carlos my key. Also — parrot named Pico, says hi :wave: Looking forward to Ramen Friday when I'm in SF.

Maya (People Ops): Noted, Pico welcome too :parrot: We'll ship a sticker pack and welcome box early next week. 

Carlos (Eng Infra): Got it — I'll watch for your DM and start the repo invites after IT confirms. Ping me for a 20-min setup call if you want pair-setup for local dev.

Marcela Ortiz: Perfect, thanks everyone!"
